avis.titre: Not for black women/ brown skin
avis.texte: I've used this pretty much every night for 2 months and I have dark spots that are still very apparent and have barely faded. Seems this is better for lighter skin with less melanin. I also wear sunscreen everyday.
I love this serum, very calming to any irritation and gives the skin a plump glow. Would highly recommend if you are acne/blemish prone. This is actually a repurchase too!

After using two bottles back­to­back, I noticed my blemishes seemed to fade a bit! Not sure if it's entirely due to this product, but I definitely saw an improvement. I can't really think of any downsides. If they came out with a larger size, that would be amazing!

It absorbed gently into my skin without any irritation, and I loved its definite soothing effect. I noticed that the redness from post­blemish marks faded, and my skin texture became noticeably smoother. The light formula finished without any stickiness, making it perfect for daily use. At first, the effects weren't immediately visible, so consistent use was necessary. On dry days, it felt a bit lacking in hydration when used alone, which was disappointing. The pump bottle made it difficult to get all the product out towards the end, which felt wasteful. I found it great to apply this serum after using a calming mask in the evening, as it significantly reduced my blemishes by the next day.

It absorbs well when sprayed and applied to the skin. The ingredients are excellent. I thought they mainly sold sheet masks, but after trying their ampoule, I was really impressed. After using it for a few days, my acne scars started to fade away. The only downside is the small amount. I'll need to stock up on 2­3 bottles during the next Olive Young sale.
It absorbs well and feels moisturizing, making it perfect for a light application. Unfortunately, it doesn't seem particularly effective at addressing blemishes.

It's a solid, easy­to­use product that's great for everyday use. When there's a sale at Olive Young, you can snag one for about 10,000 won, making it an affordable option. There's not much to criticize... It's such a basic, no­frills item that I'm at a loss for words. This review suggests that the product is a reliable, budget­friendly option without any standout features or drawbacks. It's described as 무난 (mundane or ordinary) which implies it performs its basic function without excelling or disappointing in any particular area. The reviewer finds it difficult to provide detailed feedback due to its unremarkable nature, but this isn't necessarily negative ­ it simply means the product meets basic expectations without surprises.
I've been using this product for about 5 days, and it absorbs well, making it quite nice to use. It feels a bit thick, and since it's only been 5 days, I'm not entirely sure about its effects yet.
As someone with dry, acne­prone skin, I've noticed my blemishes gradually diminishing. There's nothing to complain about. It's easy to use and I really like it. I'll probably buy more.

As someone with sensitive skin, I'm pleased to report that this product doesn't cause any itching or discomfort when applied. The texture is slightly runny, which makes it easy to spread and absorb well into the skin. I've been using this for over a month, but I'm not sure if I've noticed any significant reduction in my blemishes.

avis.titre: It absorbs well into the skin.
avis.texte: It absorbs well into the skin. There's no irritation. The application is smooth and easy. The quantity seems a bit small, so I find myself needing to repurchase it quite soon.

It's quite hydrating and leaves a rich feel on the skin after application. The absorption rate seems to be moderate. Despite being marketed as a blemish serum, it didn't make even the slightest difference in fading marks. I was seriously questioning if I was using the right product. If you're planning to buy this to get rid of blemishes, please, for your own sake, don't. It leaves a slightly rich feeling after application, so those with oily or combination dehydrated skin might want to steer clear. If you skip toner pads and just use a mist before applying this serum, it seems to reduce the rich feeling somewhat. But let me be crystal clear ­ it absolutely does not eliminate it completely!

avis.titre: For dry skin with lots of tiny...
avis.texte: For dry skin with lots of tiny sebaceous filaments A decent, reliable product Feels moisturizing and hydrating No irritation, likely suitable for most people It was advertised as a spot treatment, but I didn't see any such effects This review seems to be for a skincare product, likely a moisturizer or serum. The reviewer has dry skin with sebaceous filaments and found the product to be generally good for hydration without causing irritation. However, they were disappointed that it didn't live up to its claims of treating blemishes or spots.

avis.titre: I bought this to get rid of...
avis.texte: I bought this to get rid of acne scars, and I'm happy to see them gradually fading. It's nicely hydrating and seems like it would work well for dry to combination skin types. The only downside is that you might feel like the amount of product is a bit on the small side.

I've been using this consistently for about a month! First off, it seems to have slightly faded my blemishes. While it didn't have a significant impact on areas with heavy pigmentation, it did its job to some extent. I was also satisfied with aspects like hydration. The name Scar Serum might be a bit of an overstatement for its actual effectiveness. Of course, I wasn't expecting miraculous results in a short time, but even after using it diligently for over a month, it didn't deliver noticeably impressive results. Also, the black packaging makes it difficult to see how much product is left. However, there's surprisingly a lot of product inside, and you can keep getting more out if you shake it well. It works great when used together with Retinol Shot!

I'm currently using this product, and I can see the blemishes gradually fading away. It's really encouraging to watch the improvement! It feels slightly rich on the skin. Other than that, I don't have any particular complaints. The product seems to be effective in addressing skin concerns, though those with oily skin might want to consider the slightly rich texture. Overall, it appears to be a promising option for those looking to even out their complexion.

I was incredibly stressed about my blemish marks, but after using this product, they've noticeably faded! Of course, for dramatic changes, you'd need to visit a dermatologist. But if you're short on time or money, this is a great way to take care of your skin. Just remember, it takes consistent use over time to see results, so stick with it! The product does feel a bit heavy on the skin. This might just be me since I prefer lighter formulas, but if you're like me and enjoy lightweight textures, you might have mixed feelings about it. Also, those sensitive to fragrances might not love it. Even though I'm not great at detecting scents, this one's quite assertive ­ you can't miss it! For areas where you're concerned about marks, apply a bit more product and make sure it absorbs well. No matter how much you apply, it won't do any good if it doesn't absorb properly. Instead of just patting it in, try pressing it into the skin ­ that kind of absorption technique works best for this product.

avis.titre: It absorbs well and has a...
avis.texte: It absorbs well and has a great texture ­ not too runny or sticky. Really good stuff! I wish there was a bit more product in the container. It would be nice if they could increase the amount.

I've been using this since Lunar New Year, and at first, I was like, Why did I even buy this? But after consistent use, I've noticed my acne has calmed down significantly, and it seems like my blemish marks are fading away. Highly recommend! It absorbs well too. There's nothing particularly bad, but it's a bit disappointing that the results don't show up immediately. This review highlights the importance of patience and consistency when using skincare products. While the effects weren't instant, the reviewer saw significant improvements in their complexion over time, especially in managing acne and reducing the appearance of blemishes. The product's quick absorption is an added bonus. For those seeking immediate results, this might not be the ideal choice, but it seems to be effective for long­term skin health.

I've gone through 3 bottles of this and I'm ready to repurchase! I bought it because I had a lot of blemishes in my T­zone, and now they're almost all gone. What I love is that it absorbs well without any stickiness when applied. It doesn't make blemishes disappear dramatically or instantly, so don't expect miracles. You need to use it consistently over time to see results. I think it takes long­term use to really confirm its effectiveness. When used together with Mediheal pads, it really improves your skin and makes makeup go on beautifully.

I've been using this consistently for blemish marks, and I've noticed they've faded over time. If you're looking for quick results, I'd recommend seeing a dermatologist instead. It seems to have minimal soothing effect on existing blemishes.
I love that they frequently offer discounts, making it quite affordable. It might not be the best fit for oily skin types as it feels a bit sticky.

avis.titre: It's a decent product with a...
avis.texte: It's a decent product with a formula that absorbs well into the skin. The effect on fading blemish marks is rather underwhelming.

avis.titre: I absolutely love this! It's a...
avis.texte: I absolutely love this! It's a product where you can see the results instantly. For those with sensitive skin, it's best to avoid using this when your skin isn't in its best condition.

From the moment I started using this product, I absolutely loved its scent. When applying, it gives off a subtle, pleasant aroma reminiscent of houttuynia cordata and traditional herbal medicine. It absorbs quickly, and even though I have oily skin, I've been using it without any blemishes. The consistency is slightly thick, and the dropper format makes it easy to apply precisely where you want it. It also contains niacinamide as an ingredient, which helps with brightening effects. I had a dental surgery and, out of fear, I clenched my fist so hard that I left severe nail marks near my jaw. As the wound healed, it turned dark, so I diligently applied this product to the area, and it improved significantly! While I don't think it will be a major issue for most, some people might dislike the subtle herbal scent. This seems like the perfect product for those looking for a functional cosmetic focused on skin repair and brightening effects!

avis.titre: I absolutely love this! It's a...
avis.texte: I absolutely love this! It's a product where you can see the results instantly. For those with sensitive skin, it's best to avoid using this when your skin isn't in its best condition.

After applying this, my small blemishes significantly reduced! The scent was really pleasant, and it felt light on my skin, making it comfortable to use. I'll likely purchase it again in the future. If I had to nitpick, since I have oily skin, I felt it slightly increased the rich feeling on my face.

It absorbs well and applies smoothly. I have dry skin, and it worked perfectly for me! While using this product, I didn't experience any blemishes or deep dryness, so I can't really think of any drawbacks. Apply a thin layer at first and gently pat it in to help it absorb better.

avis.titre: After using it for a month, I...
avis.texte: After using it for a month, I noticed the blemishes fading ever so slightly. It's quite hydrating, which is nice. It really locks in the moisture well. I think I'll need to use it for a longer time and more frequently to see a significant reduction in blemishes. Other than that, I didn't notice anything particularly noteworthy. This review suggests the product is effective for hydration but may require extended use for more noticeable results in fading blemishes. The user seems generally satisfied with its moisturizing properties.

avis.titre: I have sensitive and dry skin.
avis.texte: I have sensitive and dry skin. While it might be challenging to use in winter, I've repurchased it twice because it works so well for me in spring and summer! The downside is the small amount. It's disappointing that the value for money isn't great. Try layering it twice! Apply it generously for best results.

I can't really pinpoint anything particularly impressive about this product... I tried it after using a different line, but it's just mediocre. The amount you get is disappointingly small. I'm not sure if it's actually effective, and the scent isn't that great either. It's a rather underwhelming experience overall. The product doesn't seem to stand out in any way, and the value for money is questionable given the small quantity. The lack of noticeable results and an unremarkable fragrance further contribute to its lackluster performance.
Absorbs well and has great brightening effects. It's also soothing and doesn't leave anything to be desired. The only downside is that it seems a bit pricey for the amount you get.

avis.titre: I loved how it cared for my...
avis.texte: I loved how it cared for my skin marks with niacinamide and soothed blemishes with madecassoside. It seems to require long­term use for noticeable results. If you're looking for quick effects, try a product with a higher niacinamide concentration. Be cautious though, as it may cause irritation. It's best to gradually increase the concentration. For those with super sensitive skin, it's advisable to patch test before applying to your entire face. Remember, skincare is a journey ­ what works hard for one person might not for another, so listen to your skin and adjust your routine accordingly.

avis.titre: I bought this product based on...
avis.texte: I bought this product based on the ads, and I'm seeing my blemishes gradually fade away. It seems to be working as promised! The only downside is the small size. Other than that, it works well for my skin. It's great to find a product that lives up to its marketing claims and effectively addresses skin concerns. While the size might be a bit limited, the effectiveness makes up for it, especially if it suits your skin type well.

avis.titre: It's been a week since I...
avis.texte: It's been a week since I started using the product. My boyfriend said the serum was really good from the very first day. When I looked in the mirror in the morning, my skin texture looked refined and brighter. The formula and absorption are both great, and I regret not buying it sooner. I snatched up the 100ml deal when Hwahae had it on sale!! It's really great. I'm not sure about the fading of blemishes yet since it's only been a week, but I think everyone will be satisfied with the overall improvement in skin texture and tone. Courage may seem inexpensive, but thanks to this, I feel like I can live a bit more affordably. Apply the serum gently and allow it to be absorbed before applying the next product. The Hwahae Testers also recommend using a mild toner before applying the serum.

avis.titre: It seems like a decent choice...
avis.texte: It seems like a decent choice for everyday use since it's pretty good in all aspects! While there's nothing particularly disappointing about it, it doesn't give me an overwhelmingly positive impression either.

First, the lightweight formulation was good. So after absorbing it, it seems to be absorbed without leaving a residue even when applied multiple times. Hwahae seems to be good for skin with a lot of trouble. I don't have much trouble, so I didn't feel the effects much. It was great to use the same line of face masks together!!

avis.titre: It absorbs well and sinks in...
avis.texte: It absorbs well and sinks in quickly My skin is dry with severe dehydration and redness But this product showed real results and I could apply it generously before bed without any irritation For my sensitive skin, it didn't cause any blemishes There wasn't anything particularly disappointing about it If you apply a generous amount before bed, your skin looks better the next morning
After using this, I definitely notice fewer breakouts. It's great for improving the skin barrier. The finish feels a bit sticky after application, so you need to take your time letting it absorb.

avis.titre: Absorbs well and has no scent.
avis.texte: Absorbs well and has no scent. While I'm not sure if it actually removes blemishes, it's a decent product to use. The price seems a bit on the high side. The black container makes it difficult to check how much product is left.

avis.titre: I've been using it because I...
avis.texte: I've been using it because I was troubled by blemish marks, and it seems the blemish marks have improved with consistent use!!! The texture is slightly slippery and sticky, but it is odorless and colorless. Those who wish to improve their skin would be recommended [Hwahae].

avis.titre: I was really surprised when I...
avis.texte: I was really surprised when I first used this product. The traces faded noticeably and my skin tone felt a bit more refined, which I really liked. What I liked the most was that it didn't make my skin overly oily, so I was able to maintain a fresh complexion all day long. As someone with an oily skin type, I can't use just anything, but this one didn't cause any breakouts and instead gave me a more stabilized feeling. Despite that, the reason I want to recommend this product is because the effects were just so good when I first used it. Even though I have sensitive skin, there were no issues with breakouts, and the improvement was quite dramatic in a short period of time, which I genuinely appreciated. I think the reaction might vary depending on one's skin condition and the season, but if you have similar skin concerns as I do, this is definitely a product worth trying out. unfortunately, from the third bottle onwards, the effect seems to have diminished a bit... i didn't feel the traces fading as quickly as in the beginning, and the oiliness has increased more than before... it was really impressive at first, but as time passed, that impression gradually faded, so i was a little disappointed. of course, it's not that the effect has completely disappeared, and it's still decent. it's just that the level of satisfaction wasn't as high as when i first used it. The ampoule has a slight oily residue, so it's recommended to use it only at night for oily skin.

avis.titre: I first tried this product in...
avis.texte: I first tried this product in the form of a pack rather than an ampoule. Using the pack, I felt a refreshing and soothing sensation on my face, so I also tried the ampoule. After receiving and using it, I found that the texture and scent were similar to the pack that I had used before. (I recommend trying the pack as well ­ it's really good!) The formula is not completely watery, but as you can see in the second photo, it has a slight cohesiveness. When applied, it has a soft, supple texture. However, it doesn't leave a heavy, unabsorbed feeling when spread thinly ­ instead, it absorbs quickly and provides a cooling sensation. Although I don't have acne, I do have some redness and a few red acne scars. With consistent use, these seem to be fading a bit. (I didn't have high expectations for dramatic scar fading, though.) The cooling sensation helps to reduce facial redness, and the formula doesn't dry out my skin, leaving it feeling moisturized and supple for longer. While the scars haven't faded dramatically, I haven't experienced any new breakouts, and the product has helped to lower the heat sensation on my face. I think with continued use, the effects will be more noticeable. Pigmentation and scarring do not dramatically disappear, but they do not worsen either. The redness subsides. The face feels refreshed, so it would be good to use in the summer.

I don't like sticky things, but this was moisturizing and absorbed quickly, which I liked. After using it for about 2 weeks, the acne marks gradually faded and disappeared quickly!! That's why I'm now on my third bottle! It's reliable and worth using!!! Well, I don't have much, but when I think about other skin types, the sensitive type might be a bit more delicate...?

avis.titre: I'm on my second bottle of...
avis.texte: I'm on my second bottle of this serum. The formula is thin but doesn't run or drip too much, and it spreads well. My skin is combination, but this keeps it from getting too oily or dry. It absorbs nicely, and after a few pats, my skin feels plump. Although it is called a trace serum, I'm not sure if it actually helps to erase traces. If you're buying it solely for the purpose of erasing traces, I would not recommend it, as it seems to be just a regular serum without that particular function. Using the dropper, apply the serum to each area of the face and gently pat it in, allowing it to be absorbed smoothly.

First of all, the effect! There are two sets sold at Olive Young. I bought that and used it diligently morning and evening for more than a month. The effect...is there. It's not that the spots have completely disappeared or anything, but they just seem a bit lighter and smaller? Before I compared the before and after photos I took, I really thought there was no effect at all, so I was angry.. But with the naked eye, I couldn't really tell. I've posted the before and after photos! Additionally, the advantage is that the scent is good. It has a herbal scent. If you like natural, friendly scents, you'll probably be satisfied using it. The texture is slightly viscous, so it doesn't just flow down like water, making it easy to apply. The spreadability is also good ­ it spreads smoothly. My skin type is combination, with an oily T­zone and dry U­zone. When I apply it to the back of my hand, it absorbs really quickly, and it absorbs reasonably well on my face too, but if I do a second layer or apply a lot, the absorption slows down. I wouldn't recommend layering for those with extremely dry skin... +Oh, right, I also used the Bioderma Cicabio Cream together for scar care, so it's hard to say that this serum alone was responsible for the improvement in my spots. As the name 'Trace Serum' suggests, it does not completely erase traces in a short period of time. While it does have some effect, it is unrealistic to expect a cosmetic product to completely remove traces. Time or dermatolog

avis.titre: As a person with complex skin...
avis.texte: As a person with complex skin, I purchased this product because I had too many bumps and blemishes, and I wanted to improve my skin texture. After about 2 weeks of use, I was surprised to find that the blemishes had disappeared and the bumps had completely vanished. I'm now on my second bottle, and it seems to be effectively addressing the uneven skin texture. I prefer a slightly refreshing texture, but this one felt heavier and more oily than moisturizing. I dislike a heavy and stuffy texture, so I wouldn't recommend this.

avis.titre: I purchased it because it has...
avis.texte: I purchased it because it has a large capacity and the price is reasonable. After actually using it, the troubles decreased in the early stages of use. I've been using it continuously, but I've started to feel that the effect is less noticeable compared to the beginning.

avis.titre: I've been using it for the...
avis.texte: I've been using it for the third time already since my first purchase, and I love it so much. At first, I tried the Mediheal Madecassoside mask pack, and my skin's heat sensation went down significantly, and the reddish areas on my cheeks disappeared. So I thought, Hmm, the ampoule might work well too, and I bought it. And it got rid of the redness around my nose and on my cheeks!! It also has great moisturizing power, so I use it all year round. There were no regrettable points! (The fact that the price keeps going up? ㅠㅠ) When using a modeling pack, it is recommended to mix and apply this product. I also use it that way and always apply it before makeup. This is a product I have purchased three times ­ my own money, my own purchase! :yum:

Based on my experience using the Mediheal Madecassoside Blemish Repair Serum, it was absorbed smoothly into the skin without any irritation, providing an effective soothing effect on the skin. Thanks to the madecassoside ingredient, I experienced a gradual improvement in skin irritation and blemish traces. The serum's lightweight formula did not feel sticky and left a refreshing finish, making it suitable for use even in the summer without any burden. After use, my skin felt soft and moisturized, providing a comfortable sensation without dryness or tightness. It is particularly suitable for sensitive skin and I felt it helped with skin recovery. The fragrance is subtle and non­irritating, allowing me to use it without any concerns. It was available. However, it may be somewhat insufficient for those who desire deep moisturization, so it is recommended to use it together with other moisturizing products. With consistent use, the skin can become healthier, and the traces of trouble can gradually improve. Overall, it is a product that can be recommended to those with sensitive skin or concerns about traces of trouble.:)

avis.titre: Certainly it is famous, so it...
avis.texte: Certainly it is famous, so it is quite good. It is good because there is no slippage. If you expect a big effect, I don't recommend it. However, there does seem to be some effect.

avis.titre: I tried using the Hwahae app...
avis.texte: I tried using the Hwahae app to manage skin troubles, and it seems to be quite effective. Except for the price being a bit high, everything else is fine.

Applying this after using the moisture pad leaves my skin feeling hydrated, smooth, and radiant.^^ The severe dryness has been significantly reduced. I plan to continue using this consistently. I haven't really found any shortcomings yet! I'll try to use it a bit more^^

avis.titre: Dry skin type, so very light...
avis.texte: Dry skin type, so very light ampoules are not moisturizing enough, but this one was good because the moisturizing was effective. There seems to be quite a bit of oil content, so it may not be suitable for use in the summer. As I have an oily complexion, I only apply it at night. It is well­known for its scar ampoule, but after using it for nearly a month, I'm not sure if I've noticed any dramatic effects. It may have lightened a bit, but that's about it.

avis.titre: For about 3 months of use, I...
avis.texte: For about 3 months of use, I definitely felt that the blemish marks were calming down, and it was convenient to care for the relatively small and difficult­to­focus­on blemish marks. You can just apply an appropriate amount all over the face using the dropper! I also liked that it was effective on other parts of the body besides the face. There was certainly a sense that the product capacity was insufficient, and it seems that areas such as moisturization or skin barrier should not be expected to perform greatly. As effective on other parts of the body as on the face. Personally, I think the volume is insufficient, but since it is a dropper product, the individual can control the amount of use to some extent.

avis.titre: It feels like a type that...
avis.texte: It feels like a type that flows like water, with 70% type and 30% gel type! Even before makeup, there is no sense of being pressed, and it gives a moisturizing feeling ~ To be honest, I didn't really feel the efficacy of madecassoside, but I was satisfied with its use in providing deep hydration.

I have a warm bright olive­toned complexion and a thin, combination skin type. My skin is thin and prone to blemishes, so I'm looking for a serum or essence that is lightweight and easy to apply. I prefer a runny texture that absorbs well. I found a gentle, affordable option that works well layered with a lightweight, functional essence or serum. The Hwahae Testers recommended it, and the Hwahae formula suits my skin type, though the brightening and fading effects are limited due to my age. It seems best for preventative use as an additional serum step. Individuals with dry or combination skin types should layer toner and serum multiple times after cleansing, as this helps minimize tightness during makeup application. Products with high glycerin content require more absorption time, so it is best to apply these only in the evenings. Neutral, multi­functional types will likely have moderate moisturizing effects, and younger users may experience greater satisfaction with the efficacy and spreadability.

Spreadability: The formula was not sticky and felt moisturizing, making it comfortable to apply. Absorption: I felt it absorbed quickly, as my skin became moisturized right after application. Recommended Skin Type: Dry / I have an oily T­zone, so it felt a bit greasy later, but I think it would work well for those with dry skin! It was disappointing to use. As mentioned above, it was greasy, so after applying it, there was a lot of oiliness, which was a bit inconvenient.

I'm currently on my 3rd bottle and it seems to last around 1.5 to 2 months per bottle. I tend to feel stuffy even when just slightly heavy, but this product feels refreshing and lightweight, so I've been using it more often! Skin type: Combination Effect: I started using this product skeptically about 2­3 years ago for some stubborn dark acne scars, but after using it for about 2 months, the scars faded significantly. After 2 more months, the scars were barely visible, so I bought another bottle! Recommended usage: When I just used this product alone, I didn't see much effect. But when I used it along with Redermic R 300, Madecassoside, and Hera Age Line, I definitely noticed my skin tone brightening. Even just using the Madecassoside helped fade my recent scars in about 3­4 weeks. It's not dramatic, but I'm continuing to use it as it's been helpful! The effects are not that tremendous, and there is no sense of the trouble itself being calmed. After using Lirillshot (300), the addition of madecassoside plays a regenerative role in a lightweight formulation (I found it to be good when using the Hera Age Serum).

1. Skin soothing and blemish­fading effects: Contains madecassoside and centella asiatica extract, effectively reducing redness from blemishes and fading skin marks. Users report that with consistent use, their complexion becomes more even and skin feels softer. 2. Light texture and quick absorption: The watery formula spreads smoothly on the skin and absorbs quickly without any stickiness, allowing for seamless layering with other skincare products. 3. Suitable for sensitive skin: Provides a comfortable feel without irritation, making it safe to use even on sensitive or blemish­prone skin. 1. Immediate results may be challenging: Some users mention that rather than expecting instant effects, it's necessary to use the product consistently for over a month to notice improvements. 2. Additional hydration needed for dry skin: Those with dry skin may experience some dryness after using the serum, so it's recommended to follow up with a moisturizing cream. 1. Use as a spot treatment: Apply concentrated amounts to areas with blemishes or redness for targeted care. 2. Refrigerate before use: Storing the serum in the refrigerator adds a cooling effect, enhancing its soothing properties. 3. Layer for intensive care: Depending on your skin's condition, applying an extra layer of serum can boost its hydrating and calming effects.

As someone with combination skin prone to acne, I've been really stressed about recent blemish marks. I was surprised to see the marks gradually fading, and I found the product absorbs really well too. If you're looking to avoid stickiness, you might find this product a bit disappointing. It tends to make hair stick to your face.

I've been using this product for 4 weeks (purchased with my own money) on my combination dehydrated and blemish­prone skin. The verdict: the results aren't bad at all. While individual experiences may vary, I noticed the most significant improvements after about 2 weeks of use. Beyond that point, it seems my skin adapted, and the changes became more subtle rather than dramatically visible. Nevertheless, I'm still seeing gradual improvements in finer details of my complexion. I'm continuing to use it, believing that with consistent application, I'll see even better results. (By the way, the product lasts longer than I expected!) The finish isn't as clean as I'd hoped; there's a slight feeling of oil sitting on top of the skin, which is a bit disappointing.

It absorbs well and feels gentle on the skin, leaving it noticeably hydrated! My skin tends to be super sensitive and prone to scarring, but I can see the marks gradually fading! The amount you can get with one dropper seems a bit small! It's also a bit challenging to use up the product at the bottom when you're almost finished... When you're nearly done, try storing it upside down with the cap off. The remaining product will collect at the bottom, and you can easily pull out the dropper stem to access it.

avis.titre: It absorbs well and has great...
avis.texte: It absorbs well and has great application. Works wonderfully with face masks! The dropper doesn't seem to draw up the product very efficiently. Other than that, it's good.

avis.titre: It absorbs well and has a...
avis.texte: It absorbs well and has a great texture. It was definitely effective in calming my skin. While it claims to have brightening effects, I didn't notice any significant visible results.

I've been using this consistently since January, and I can definitely see my blemishes fading! It absorbs well, leaving my skin feeling firm and supple. The results are so good that I've purchased it three times already! Admittedly, it's a bit pricier compared to other serums on the market. I use it right after cleansing and applying my exfoliating toner. I've found that layering this serum followed by a cica cream seems to enhance its effectiveness even more!

It's effective for reducing redness and pigmentation left behind after blemishes heal! There wasn't really anything disappointing about it, except maybe the occasional appearance of small bumps? That's about it.

avis.titre: I'm on my third bottle and I...
avis.texte: I'm on my third bottle and I love it!! Definitely a repurchase for me! Can't think of any downsides. I've been using it for over a year and I'm really happy with it! It works great when applied before your emulsion!

I've been using this consistently for about 3 months, and it absorbs well without feeling sticky. As someone with slightly dry skin, I found it nicely hydrating when applied as part of my skincare routine. I bought this for blemish care, but I didn't see much effect. I didn't notice any visible fading or lightening of marks. It's okay as a lightweight base product, but if you're concerned about blemishes, I'd recommend skipping this one!

avis.titre: I had a lot of acne scars, but...
avis.texte: I had a lot of acne scars, but after using it for a month, it seems to have improved significantly When applied, the areas around the nose or sensitive skin seem to sting quite a bit.

avis.titre: It's gentle on the skin and...
avis.texte: It's gentle on the skin and doesn't leave a sticky residue after application, which I really appreciate. I don't see any dramatic effects. It's just good for everyday casual use. It might work well if mixed with other serums.

Application: The lightweight and gentle formula spreads easily on the skin without irritation. It absorbs without stickiness and doesn't pill even with multiple layers, making it perfect for both morning and evening routines. I'm particularly satisfied with how smoothly it applies to blemish­prone areas. Absorption: While it absorbs lightly, it does take a bit of time to fully sink in. It forms a protective layer on the skin, so it's best to wait a moment before moving to the next step. Overall, the absorption is good, leaving a fresh finish. Soothing effect: Thanks to madecassoside and tea tree ingredients, it seems excellent at calming irritated skin. It's particularly effective for blemish marks, redness, and localized inflammation. The soothing power is top­notch, especially considering it's gentle enough for sensitive skin! Regeneration/Mark fading: While it does show effects in fading blemish marks and scars with consistent use, some say it takes over two weeks of regular application to see noticeable results. It seems more suited for long­term use rather than quick fixes. Irritation level: With its nearly fragrance­free and mild formulation, there's absolutely no irritation. Even those with sensitive skin can use it with confidence. The absence of alcohol and strong fragrances makes it highly recommended for sensitive and blemish­prone skin. Recommended for: Sensitive, blemish­prone, acne­prone, combination skin Highly suitable for those concerned with redness and blem
It's moisturizing and absorbs well, making it easy to use on a daily basis. There's nothing particularly disappointing about it. I'm using it with satisfaction.
It's great for lightweight application! Absorbs well and creates a perfect base for makeup Although it's marketed as a spot treatment serum, honestly, I didn't see much improvement on my blemishes

Highly recommended for combination dehydrated and sensitive skin types. Both the absorption and how it applies are satisfying. The price compared to the amount is a bit steep. I wish there were more frequent discounts.
It seems great for fading blemishes. Applying it before bed gives excellent results. The product feels quite similar to a sheet mask essence, but personally, I find masks even more effective.

avis.titre: I used this product from the...
avis.texte: I used this product from the third week of March to the first week of May. While it did help with blemishes and redness, the effects weren't dramatic. The best features were its quick absorption and non­sticky texture. I think even those with oily skin could use it without issues. The product suited me well, so there weren't any major problems, but I didn't find the results to be particularly outstanding. Using it both morning and night seemed to yield better results.

avis.titre: I'm on my second bottle now...
avis.texte: I'm on my second bottle now, and while it doesn't provide dramatic blemish care, I feel like my skin is gradually becoming brighter There weren't any major downsides in terms of application or blemishes, but I think I should try other spot­treating serums as well

I absolutely cannot stress enough how amazing this is! Seriously, I wholeheartedly recommend buying it. It's especially fantastic for acne­prone skin or if your skin barrier is compromised. It's just too good! What's more, compared to other ampoules, it seems to last longer ­ you don't go through it as quickly. There's only one tiny drawback ­ the scent is a bit odd. It has a slightly medicinal smell. If it weren't for that, it would be perfect. Here's a pro tip: Apply this, then use Torriden toner with a cotton pad before bed. Trust me, you'll wake up to flawless skin!

It absorbs well and applies smoothly, which I really liked. It seems to be a genuinely gentle product that doesn't cause any irritation. However, while it's very gentle, I didn't really notice any other soothing effects.

avis.titre: After using it for 3 days, I...
avis.texte: After using it for 3 days, I could definitely see that the darker areas of my skin had noticeably lightened. I'm satisfied with how smoothly it absorbs and how well it moisturizes. I'd recommend this to those with dry or combination dehydrated skin. I'll need to use it longer to know for sure, but so far I haven't found anything to complain about.
Incredibly hydrating. In summer, I can skip cream and just use this for my skincare routine. I'm not sure if it's fading marks yet, but it does seem less irritating to my skin.

I bought this for treating blemish marks, and I saw results in just one day. With consistent use, it definitely fades acne scars. The moisturizing finish was great, and the effectiveness was good too, so I didn't really have any complaints. Using it as a booster healer really enhanced its absorption, making the effects more noticeable.

It's really effective at fading acne scars, so I'm now on my third bottle! The scent is lovely too. There weren't many downsides, but if you apply too much, it can feel oily and doesn't absorb well. For best results, apply just enough for your skin to absorb!

Application: Just like the familiar feeling when applying your usual serum! It's not very viscous and glides on smoothly, with a slight tendency to run when applied directly to the skin. Absorption: While not entirely water­like in texture, it has that typical serum consistency that absorbs quickly. It's perfect for combination dehydrated skin that doesn't like oiliness. Those with dry skin might feel immediate dryness if used alone. Recommended Skin Type: Highly recommended for skin with blemish marks! I occasionally get breakouts, so while I don't have many significant marks, I've seen quite good results! It seems more effective on acne scars rather than dark spots, and you can really see improvement, especially on newer marks! I'm on my second bottle thanks to a buy­one­get­one deal, and so far, I haven't found any downsides! I've heard it works well with microneedling, so I tried it ­ and the results were truly impressive! I used it every night along with 1.0mm microneedling, and it was quite effective for treating marks. However, I didn't notice significant effects when using it alone.

avis.titre: I love how it applies lightly...
avis.texte: I love how it applies lightly and absorbs quickly. After using one bottle, I noticed my blemishes have significantly brightened. I didn't find any particular drawbacks. I'll have to look for some when I use it for the second time.
It's decent and suitable. Absorbs well into the skin. Likely a good match for dry skin types. Becomes sticky if applied multiple times. After two weeks of use, I'm not sure about its effectiveness.

[Ampoule Review] Hydration Boost + Soothing Care, My Daily Pick! My Skin Type ; User Experience: Skin Type: Slightly oily T­zone, dry elsewhere Usage: Ampoule substitute, intensive hydration and soothing care Facts: 1) Absorbs lightly without stickiness 2) Sinks right into the skin, allowing seamless layering of subsequent products 3) When generously applied to blemish­prone areas, redness and heat reduced in 2­3 days Problem­Solving ; Effects: Blemish Care: Safe to use even on sudden breakouts Oil­Moisture Balance: Hydrates dry, flaky areas without irritation Recovery: Quickly calms sensitive skin, adding stability to daily routines Unexpected Family Favorite! My elementary school­aged niece loved the scent and used it a couple of times. Now it's on her vanity! If a child with sensitive skin can use it without issues, it's highly recommended for the whole family! Overall Rating ; Selling Points: • :100: Absorption / Soothing power / Fragrance • :woman:

I'm currently on my third bottle after finishing two. Usually, even with serums I like, I find the effects diminish after the first bottle, as if my skin gets used to it. But with this one, my acne scars have noticeably faded, so I breezed through two bottles and I'm now on my third. I've even stocked up with two more bottles at home! My skin is super sensitive and very oily, but this works well even when applied during the toner step before makeup. There wasn't really anything disappointing about it. If I had to pick something, maybe the price? I think using this together with MediCube's blue spot treatment pads makes the effects faster and more noticeable!

I've been using this every evening since I bought it, and it's been amazing! My blemishes have significantly reduced. The only downside is that it doesn't seem to provide deep hydration and feels like it sits on the surface of the skin. When used together with madecassoside spot treatment pads, it really helps fade marks and scars.

It didn't feel tingling or irritating on my skin, and it was fine for me. However, my sister has more sensitive skin, and she experienced a slight tingling sensation and a bit of redness. Just something to keep in mind! It feels a bit rich on the skin, and it doesn't dramatically erase blemishes.

Excellent at fading acne scars and blemishes, making them barely noticeable The bottle feels small after using it for a while, and it's disappointing that you can't see how much product is left due to the opaque packaging After incorporating it into my daily routine, both morning and night, I could really feel the difference as those unsightly scars became less visible
It absorbs really well, feels moisturizing, and sinks into the skin nicely. Absolutely fantastic! I haven't found any downsides yet. I'm using it diligently and loving it so far.

I was struggling with acne scars and sensitive skin, but after using this product daily, I've noticed the marks gradually fading away. I'm now on my fourth bottle! The product quantity seems smaller than expected, so it feels like I'm going through it rather quickly.

avis.titre: I've been using this for about...
avis.texte: I've been using this for about 5 months. While there weren't any dramatic changes, I noticed a slight reduction in redness. It seems to work well on minor blemishes with mild redness, rather than deep, scar­like marks. Overall, I've seen a subtle improvement in my skin texture. After application, my skin feels excessively oily... Even though I don't typically have very oily skin, this product makes my face incredibly shiny. I wouldn't recommend it for those with sensitive skin. In my case, when my skin was slightly irritated, using this product caused a slight stinging sensation. As mentioned earlier, it doesn't seem effective on deeper blemishes.

avis.titre: It absorbs well and has great...
avis.texte: It absorbs well and has great application! It was thinner than expected, which made it easy to use! There's nothing particularly disappointing. I think I need to use it more to fully evaluate.

I'm always satisfied with the texture as it's moisturizing and absorbs well. I'm on my second bottle and if I finish it, I'd definitely consider repurchasing. I'm not sure if it completely eliminates blemishes, but it definitely improves skin texture compared to when I don't use it. I applied this once on each cheek before using a gua sha tool! It's more hydrating than other products, so even with intense gua sha, it doesn't feel too painful. I highly recommend it!

avis.titre: I used this product for about...
avis.texte: I used this product for about two months, from November 24, 2024 to February 17, 2025. The formula has a water­like consistency that absorbs well into the skin and doesn't leave a sticky residue, which I really liked. I have blemish­prone skin and have tried many products, but I've never seen such impressive results before! It contains a high concentration of niacin, which might be why it's less irritating and more effective for brightening than other vitamin ampoules I've tried. It's been great for treating small bumps and inflammatory acne. Plus, the generous amount of product makes it convenient to use. The effects don't show up immediately within 1­2 weeks, which was a bit disappointing. For the first couple of weeks, the changes were subtle. However, as time passed, I started noticing gradual improvements, and by the time I finished the bottle, the difference in my complexion was striking. This has truly become my holy grail product! For best results, apply a thin layer after your toner and make sure it's fully absorbed before moving on to the next step. On particularly dry days, try mixing it with your moisturizer for an extra hydration boost. The lightweight formula blends well with creams, making it a versatile addition to your skincare routine!

It absorbs beautifully without any greasiness, and I think it's really effective on acne scars! Everything else is great, but the price seems a bit steep for the amount you get. If it weren't for that, it would be perfect! It makes me want to use it sparingly...

avis.titre: I always get a pimple or two...
avis.texte: I always get a pimple or two on my chin before that time of the month, and it used to leave slight marks that made me feel down. While this product doesn't completely eliminate them, it definitely fades them noticeably! It's also hydrating, and there's almost no sticky feeling after it absorbs. I feel like the effectiveness gradually diminishes with continued use. For the first month, the fading was really noticeable, but now I'm not so sure... Applying this product generously doesn't increase its effectiveness and only leads to more blemishes. Using a moderate amount and ensuring it absorbs well gives the best results.

I've always been concerned about blemishes, but I can visibly see them fading gradually. Now I'm only using this serum. Madecassoside is truly revolutionary! I think I'll stick with this product for life. I usually dislike products that feel oily, but this one isn't greasy at all and doesn't feel sticky. It's perfect for me! I didn't find any drawbacks! Everything about this product worked well for me.

avis.titre: I've been using this for about...
avis.texte: I've been using this for about a month, and my blemishes have significantly reduced. The application is smooth, and there's no sticky feeling, which I love. It works well with my combination skin. If there's one downside, it's the product's scent. It has a somewhat unusual fragrance. However, it's not bothersome enough to interfere with using the product.

avis.titre: Even though I have oily skin...
avis.texte: Even though I have oily skin, this absorbs well and has an excellent texture. It applies smoothly without any stickiness. While my blemish marks didn't disappear dramatically, I can see my blemishes gradually subsiding. It's really effective for calming the skin. Unlike some other reviews, my blemishes and marks didn't vanish instantly. I love applying this product after using toner pads or misting my face. It leaves my skin feeling hydrated without any burning sensation.

I absolutely loved how it absorbs without any stickiness! While my acne has significantly improved, I've been working on managing the remaining blemishes. Though there's no dramatic change, I've noticed the marks are gradually fading with consistent use. I recommend using this along with the spot treatment pads from the same line.

I bought this because it's famous for helping with acne scars and redness. It seems to work really well for people with lots of blemishes and acne marks! The texture isn't heavy, it's more like a slightly thin serum!

It provides hydration that's moisturizing without feeling greasy, making it suitable for use all year round Given its fame, I had pretty high expectations for this ampoule. I'll keep using it to see how it goes

avis.titre: I have dry skin, and as we...
avis.texte: I have dry skin, and as we know, it's not easy to get rid of blemishes. Even with consistent use, they only faded slightly and didn't completely disappear. Still, I'm satisfied with the improvement ­ any fading is better than none! The product is quite rich, leaving my face feeling oily after application. This makes my skin feel uncomfortable.

avis.titre: I use this to combat dryness.
avis.texte: I use this to combat dryness. If you're struggling with deep dryness, it might be worth giving it a try. Did it eliminate blemishes? I'm not sure about that. Also, those with super sensitive skin might experience a tingling sensation when using it.

avis.titre: I love it! It seems to be...
avis.texte: I love it! It seems to be fading my scars. Even though I have sensitive skin, I didn't experience any reactions. There's nothing bad to say. It doesn't cause any blemishes, which is great. I feel like my scars are becoming less noticeable.

avis.titre: As someone with dry skin, I...
avis.texte: As someone with dry skin, I appreciated the light hydration it provided, However, it completely failed to deliver on its main advertised function of erasing blemishes... Since it didn't seem to cause any blemishes, I managed to use it up due to its lightweight feel. I'm afraid I don't have any special tips to share!

I definitely felt like it improved the appearance of blemishes. It also absorbed well into my skin. The scent was a bit off­putting, and there was a slight tingling sensation, but overall it was pretty good!

I've been using this since last year, and I love how it applies so smoothly and absorbs really well! I have combination skin and was worried about acne scars, but my skin is super sensitive, so I couldn't use just anything. This product, however, works great for me. I'd highly recommend it to anyone struggling with acne scars! There wasn't really anything disappointing about it. It absorbs well, and I noticed fewer blemishes than before I started using it, which was fantastic.

I can definitely feel an improvement in my skin texture. This is a product I've purchased with my own money and I'm already on my fourth bottle. For my combination dehydrated skin, it was perfect during the dry winter months. However, as the weather got warmer and my skin became oilier, it started to feel a bit sticky.

avis.titre: I've been using this for about...
avis.texte: I've been using this for about a month, and first off, it has a scent reminiscent of men's skincare products. I didn't mind it, but those sensitive to fragrances might not be fans. The texture has just the right amount of viscosity! I didn't see as dramatic results as the ads promised. Still, it's probably better than not using anything at all!

avis.titre: I'm already on my third bottle...
avis.texte: I'm already on my third bottle of this product. It provides ample hydration, and with continued use, I can feel my skin barrier becoming stronger. There's definitely a soothing effect, so I recommend it to people with blemish­prone skin around me. Throughout my consistent use, I don't think I've ever experienced any blemishes due to this product. There's nothing particularly disappointing about it. I just wish it came in a larger size!
I absolutely love it! It's really fantastic! So hydrating and gentle on the skin. There's honestly nothing to complain about. It was just great all around!

As someone with dry, blemish­prone skin, I rarely get pustular acne, but when my skin was in turmoil and pustules started appearing, I stumbled upon this product on YouTube. I bought it with some skepticism, but it seemed to calm my skin down! Plus, since I have dry skin, I need hydration, and this provides just the right amount of moisture. It's even great to use before makeup! The price isn't too steep either, so it's an even better deal when you catch it on sale! Those with oily skin might find it a bit heavy before makeup in the summer... But it's great for dry skin! While it doesn't completely eliminate blemishes overnight, when used diligently alongside pharmacy ointments, it seems to calm the skin down within 3 days to a week!

It's incredibly gentle. When my skin was irritated and painful, I couldn't apply anything else, but I could use this. I've been using it for about two months, but it hasn't been very helpful for blemish marks.

It's great that it's hydrating and applies thinly. This would be perfect for those with combination dehydrated skin! After using my second bottle, I've noticed it feels a bit rich on the skin. When I first bought it, I had a lot of blemishes on the right side of my face. I applied one pump generously to my right cheek in the evening and again in the morning. After two weeks, the blemishes on my right cheek completely disappeared!

I've been using this neutral toner for about two months now. It's great because it feels hydrating and soothing at the same time. It doesn't have any effect on blemishes or brightening. While it provides hydration, those with dry skin might find it a bit lacking. If you apply a generous amount before using the Mediheal Madecassoside mask, your skin feels even better the next day.

avis.titre: After using it for about a...
avis.texte: After using it for about a week, I think it's a great soothing serum for oily skin types. Although it's called a 'trace serum', I didn't feel like it improved any marks on my skin.

As expected, Mediheal is a brand you can trust. The application is great, it absorbs well, and effectively combats deep dryness. Being a serum, it applies lightly while maintaining excellent hydration. I really like it! There's absolutely nothing bad to say. This is my holy grail serum. I want to use it for the rest of my life!

I've been using the Madecassoside Blemish Repair Serum for a few weeks now, and the results have exceeded my expectations. The serum effectively reduces redness, soothes irritation, and helps heal breakouts faster. The texture is light, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave a sticky feeling. I especially appreciate that it doesn't cause tightness or trigger new blemishes. It's suitable even for my sensitive skin. A big plus is the formula with madecassoside — it truly works. My skin looks more even and well­cared for. I'll definitely be ordering it again! Highly recommend for anyone with sensitive or acne­prone skin.

After using this product and its pad version for a while, I noticed a slight lightening of pigmentation. The fragrance is quite strong. It's expensive for the amount you get. I recommend buying the larger size when it's on sale.

avis.titre: I apply this as the first step...
avis.texte: I apply this as the first step after cleansing with toner. While the watery texture makes it a bit challenging to spread, it absorbs quickly. The large size allows for generous application. The dropper format ensures hygienic use. It's suitable for all skin types. I've been using it for over two weeks without any blemishes appearing. The overall gentle ingredients make me feel at ease using it. I notice my skin imperfections seem to be fading. The very watery consistency makes it slightly difficult to spread smoothly. Perhaps due to its texture, it doesn't feel as concentrated with nourishing ingredients as I'd like.
